lyrics:
【Edge of Night / Late Night City】

Ooh ooh ooh...
Oh oh oh... Oh oh oh... Oh oh...

Streetlights paint the pavement gold,
Another story to unfold.
3 AM, the city sleeps,
But my restless spirit leaps.
Through empty avenues I roam,
This concrete jungle is my home.

Lost in the humming neon glow,
Where the lonely wanderers go,
A silent promise in the air,
No one to see, no one to care.

Yeah, I'm walking on the edge of night,
Bathes in artificial light,
Lonely? Yes. But feeling free.
Just the city and me.
This electric dream I chase,
At my own determined pace.

No destination, no clear plan,
Just the rhythm of a wandering man.
Each step a beat, each breath a rhyme,
Lost and found in space and time.
notes: 轉換與歌詞主體高度匹配。差異：1) 'humming'辨識為'humb'（少了一个n）；2) 'Bathes'→'Bathed'（時態）；3) 轉換包含額外四段Verse（影子、退縮、反抗種子、寂寥舞步、樹影等原創內容）未見於歌詞文字檔。實際演唱版本比歌詞檔多出約80%內容，建議同步更新歌詞檔。
